config.preRequestScript:
// A stand-in for a login API: the echo server sends back the token we send.
ancr.variables.newToken = "demo-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);

// A counter kept in the environment: it goes up by one on every send.
ancr.environment.callCount = String(Number(ancr.environment.callCount ?? 0) + 1);

items.name: Set a cookie (the redirect sends it back)

config.testScript:
ancr.test("the cookie is kept", () => ancr.expect(ancr.cookies.get("flavour")).toBe("oatmeal"));
ancr.test("and sent after the redirect", () => ancr.expect(ancr.response.json().cookies.flavour).toBe("oatmeal"));
ancr.test("the kept cookie is sent", () => ancr.expect(ancr.response.json().cookies.flavour).toBe("oatmeal"));
ancr.test("no cookies are sent", () => ancr.expect(ancr.response.json().cookies).toEqual({}));
